page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.48xlarge is a high-density compute-optimized instance designed for large-scale parallel processing. Operating on KVM hypervisor architecture, it features an Intel Xeon 8475B x86_64 processor clocked at 2.7 GHz with 192 dedicated vCPUs. The server is equipped with 512 GB of RAM, providing an allocation of 2.67 GB per virtual core. It does not include local storage disks or discrete GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network storage configurations. High-speed data transfers are enabled via a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps.

The hardware profile prioritizes CPU density over RAM-heavy configurations, establishing high qualitative cost efficiency for compute-bound operations that do not demand extensive memory footprints per core. The absence of local NVMe storage requires external volume attachments, which offloads disk management but necessitates reliance on network storage for IOPS performance. The 100 Gbps networking ensures high throughput for node-to-node communication across large clusters.

This instance configuration is targeted at compute-heavy, multi-threaded applications. Suitable workloads include continuous integration and build automation, high-concurrency web serving clusters, batch processing jobs, financial modeling, and data transformation or ETL pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.48xlarge is a high-density compute-optimized server instance designed for compute-intensive enterprise workloads. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at 2.7 GHz, this instance provides 192 dedicated vCPUs alongside 512 GB of RAM, yielding a ratio of roughly 2.67 GB of memory per core. Operating on a KVM hypervisor, the server does not feature local block storage or discrete GPU acceleration, relying on network-attached storage architectures. Networking is supported by a 100 Gbps baseline bandwidth capability, allowing efficient data transfer for distributed execution. The high core count combined with strong network throughput makes it economically efficient for large-scale compute parallelization without paying for excess memory overhead. The ecs.c8i.48xlarge is well-suited for high-performance compute tasks, large batch processing, continuous integration pipelines, web serving clusters, and complex ETL jobs.
